Name: Sebastian's Less Wide Beach Portrait
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
Updated for version 1.6!

Sebastian's beach portrait has oddly wide shoulders, so as it says on the tin I slimmed them down. Now he has the bodytype of a string bean both at home and at the beach! Here's a comparison between the original beach portrait and his home portrait, and a comparison between the new beach portrait and the original one:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hU29u2N.png[/img]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/TwkdDZs.gif[/img]


[b]Requires[/b] Content Patcher and SMAPI

[b]Install[/b] by unzipping and moving the [i](CP) Less Wide Beach Seb[/i] folder in to Stardew Valley/Mods
If you've downloaded this mod previously, you may have a version with a folder that has a bunch of numbers in the name. I recommend deleting that old folder before moving the new one in to the Mods-folder.

Manifest.Name: Less wide Beach Sebastian
Manifest.Description: Makes Sebastians beach portrait less wide
